Which states have built the most solar photovoltaic generating capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS solar_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology = 'Solar Photovoltaic' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did Maricopa County, Arizona split between the presidential candidates in 2024?

SELECT candidate, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'ARIZONA' AND county_name = 'MARICOPA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6
Which states have the youngest residents, by median age?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b01002' AND a.variable = 'B01002_E001' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
What is the molecular formula of testosterone?
SELECT c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '6013'
Which states have the most registered hazardous waste handlers?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a typical NIH R01 research grant cost in fiscal 2024?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(total_cost AS double))) AS avg_total_cost FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' AND activity = 'R01' AND try_cast(total_cost AS double) > 0
Which countries issued the most drug warnings recorded in ChEMBL?
SELECT warning_country, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_warning WHERE warning_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Materials Project entries are theoretical, with no known lab synthesis?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(theoretical AS varchar) = 'true'
Which New York subsidized housing projects have the most units?
SELECT name, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states LIKE 'NY%' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How often does the Texas regulator confirm an insurance complaint?
SELECT finding_type, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states drew the most from the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2020?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS withdrawn FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '21-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent WHERE c0 = '4091'
Which reliability regions had the most units reporting to EPA in 2023?
SELECT nerc_region, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND nerc_region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published applications later became granted patents?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS granted FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_granted_pgpubs_crosswalk WHERE patent_id <> ''
Which counties have the youngest populations by median age?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(median_age_tot AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.popest_cc_est_agesex WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
What is the exact mass of caffeine, in daltons?
SELECT try_cast(c2 AS double) AS exact_mass FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '2519'
Which genes or proteins are named in the most chemistry patents?

SELECT e.corrected_text AS gene_or_protein, count(DISTINCT l.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_locations AS l JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_entities AS e ON cast(e.id AS varchar) = cast(l.entity_id AS varchar) JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_types AS t ON cast(t.id AS varchar) = cast(e.type_id AS varchar) WHERE t.type_name = 'GeneOrProtein' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Is atorvastatin or rosuvastatin prescribed more often under Medicare in Ohio?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT gnrc_name, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'OH' AND gnrc_name IN ('Atorvastatin Calcium', 'Rosuvastatin Calcium') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which compounds go by the most synonyms in PubChem?

SELECT t.c1 AS compound, count(*) AS synonyms FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_synonym_filtered AS s JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = s.c0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rules on the fall 2024 agenda were expected to be major rules?
SELECT count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' AND major = 'Yes'
Which states have the largest number of public schools?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much heat input did U.S. power plants report burning in 2020, in million Btu?
SELECT sum(try_cast(heat_input_mmbtu AS double)) AS heat_input_mmbtu FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) = 2020
What form types made up most of EDGAR's 2021 filings?
SELECT form_type, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.edgar_index_master WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many regulatory reviews did OIRA complete in each recent year?
SELECT substr(cast(date_completed AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of opinion make up the archive: lead, concurring, dissenting?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinions WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much solar power did California's grid operator generate in 2023?

SELECT round(sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double)))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'CISO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which drugs are prescribed most often under Medicare Part D, by claims?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT brnd_name, try_cast(tot_clms AS double) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How were full-service electricity customers split among co-ops, municipal and investor-owned utilities in 2020?

SELECT column07 AS ownership, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(customers_4 AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(customers_4 AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which recipients received the largest single grants in fiscal 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, try_cast(total_obligation AS double) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category = 'grant' AND cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of nursing facility cost reports change from 2012 to 2024?
SELECT cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_snf10_rpt WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) IN ('2012', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the highest unemployment rates in December 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS state, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'A' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many quantum physics papers were first posted to arXiv in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE primary_category = 'quant-ph' AND substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) = '2023'
Which enforcement actions are taken most often against hazardous waste handlers?
SELECT enforcement_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements WHERE enforcement_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York's highest hourly electricity demand in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(demand_mw AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which counties have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did the price index for eggs change from January to December 2023?
SELECT period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SEFH' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2023' AND period IN ('M01', 'M12') ORDER BY period
Which occupations pay the highest median wage in the United States?

SELECT occ_title, try_cast(a_median AS double) AS median_pay FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE area_title = 'U.S.' AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' AND try_cast(a_median AS double) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many dissenting opinions does the archive hold?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinions WHERE type = '040dissent'
Which large cities have the highest share of residents born abroad?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E003' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_foreign_born FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '1600000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b05012' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How are trademarks drawn: standard characters, stylised lettering or designs?

SELECT CASE substr(mark_draw_cd, 1, 1) WHEN '1' THEN 'typed words' WHEN '2' THEN 'design only' WHEN '3' THEN 'design with words' WHEN '4' THEN 'standard characters' WHEN '5' THEN 'stylised words or letters' WHEN '6' THEN 'no drawing (sound, scent)' ELSE 'other' END AS drawing, count(*) AS marks, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies own or operate the most units in EPA's 2023 Clean Air Markets data?
SELECT owneroperator, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND owneroperator IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of federal contract actions in fiscal year 2024 were competed with only one offer?
SELECT number_of_offers_received, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
